newsitem.title: USA: Consumat Systems restates Q3 earnings down.
newsitem.headline: Consumat Systems restates Q3 earnings down.

text.p: Consumat Systems Inc said it restated its third quarter earnings lower to $73,906 or $0.06 a share due to accounting rules relating to its Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
For the nine months ended September 30, the company adjusted its net income lower to $217,388 or $0.17 per share.
The income originally reported for the third quarter was $116,095 or $0.12 per share and for the nine months was $383,074 or $0.38 per share.
